YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.

  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.

  

**We are looking forward to hire Linux Professionals in the following areas :**

  

**Experience**
--------------

3-5 Years

**Job Description**
-------------------

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  

* Provisioning: Deploy and configure Linux servers and VMware virtual machines.
* Monitoring: Track system health daily using AWS CloudWatch and vCenter.
* Troubleshooting: Resolve basic OS alerts, CPU spikes, and disk space issues.
* Maintenance: Apply regular patches to Linux systems and VMware templates.
* Automation: Write complex scripts to automate repetitive infrastructure deployment tasks.
* Optimization: Analyze CloudWatch data to right-size EC2 instances and reduce costs.
* Escalation: Act as the technical escalation point for junior team members.

Knowledge on AWS compute, Networking, Storage & Security

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree.
* Minimum 4 years in a hybrid infrastructure administration role.
* Certifications: AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, VMware Certified Professional (VCP).
* ITIL v4 Foundation
* Candidates who are confident of clearing extensive Background verification till previous Organization only shall apply

PREFERRED SKILLS
  

* Infrastructure as Code: Basic exposure to Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Configuration Management: Familiarity with Ansible playbook
* Containers: Experience managing Docker containers or Kubernetes clusters.

BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES:
  

* Problem Solver: Demonstrates strong analytical skills during complex system outages.
* Ownership: Takes full accountability for assigned infrastructure projects.
* Adaptability: Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

**Required Technical/ Functional Competencies**
-----------------------------------------------

PRIMARY SKILLS:
  

* Linux: Advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and kernel parameter optimization.
* VMware: Managing vSAN, High Availability (HA), Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS).
* AWS: Designing infrastructure using Transit Gateways, RDS, and Auto Scaling.
* AWS CloudWatch: Implementing custom metrics, CloudWatch Logs Insights, and automated actions.
* Fluent in English, in both oral and written communication
* Willingness to do 24x7 Rotational Shift, ability to working from office is preferred, location will be city with Yash Office.

DESIRABLE SKILLS:
  

* Hybrid Cloud: Managing connectivity between on-premises VMware environments and AWS.
* Security: Implementing IAM policies, security groups, and Linux hardening guidelines.

**Required Behavioral Competencies**
------------------------------------

**Accountability:**

* Takes ownership for and ensures accuracy of own work, meets deadlines, and asks questions about possible gaps to ensure clarity of ownership.

**Agility:**

* Demonstrates a willingness to accept and embrace differing ideas or perceptions which are beneficial to the organization.

**Collaboration:**

* Participates in team activities and reaches out to others in team to achieve common goals.

**Customer Focus:**

* Displays awareness of customers stated needs and gives priority to meeting and exceeding customer expectations at or above expected quality within stipulated time.

**Communication:**

* Effectively communicates in written and oral form, well-organized thoughts to others. Speaks openly and honestly with all employees.

**Drives Results:**

* Demonstrates a "can do" attitude and is willing to stretch self to achieve and exceed defined goals/targets.

**Certifications**
------------------

Mandatory: CA, AZ104, MCSA, Business Intelligence Development Certification, Microsoft Certified Azure AI, Azure Data & Azure Administrator; Desirable: OCP, CCP/Yash defined course, Administration level Certification of any Storage Tool/Backup Tool

Mandatory: ITIL V4 Foundation

NCA - Nutanix Certified Associate
